summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, professional software engineer, former biochemist, strong advocate for universal health care, critical of corporate practices and executive pay, passionate about travel and outdoor activities, engaged in political discussions, skeptical of the tech industry's treatment of older workers, experienced in version control systems (Git and SVN), critical of the current state of higher education and its value, supportive of scientific research and education, interested in bioinformatics, and has a nuanced understanding of economic and social issues.
